display.purpose: Bold tight geometric sans on poster cards.

mono.purpose: Parenthetical tags, specs, and command lines.

narrative.overview: Aligned directly with smem.chaosyn.com: sharp 0px structural rules, monumental 9-row pixel display typography, orthogonal pixel weaves, a framed pixel fox portrait with calm blink animation, and flush 2x2 Bauhaus project poster cards.
keyCharacteristics: 9-row bold pixel display wordmark EVEPUPIL and 4-column pixel metric strip.
Framed 28x28 graphic pixel fox portrait over an Orchid plus-weave field.
Flush 2x2 clickable SVG poster cards for NextDevTpl, CloudMind, SMem, and DeverDesk.
Calm, non-strobing micro-animations with prefers-reduced-motion support.
dos: Do maintain 0px sharp corners, 1px structural rules, and Light/Dark SVG parity.
donts: Don't add rapid flashing animations, rounded pill clutter, or decorative emojis.
